description: Use this when an owner who signed in by phone wants notices about their gym plan sent to an email. Read the email back to the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. An empty email clears it, and notices go to the account's own email or phone. It is never shown to members. It needs a connected Phorme account.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to this email.

email.description: The owner's email, or "" to clear it.

name: set_owner_email
title: Set my owner email
